title: PASTE YOUR COURSE TITLE HERE
subtitle: e.g. annual refresher · knowledge base + assessment prep
_how_to_use: Fill in sections (your notes), flashcards (recall prompts) and questions (your self-test bank).
Delete any array you do not need — an empty array is fine.
Keep this file valid JSON: double quotes, no trailing commas, no comments. Run `python3 tools/validate.py` to check.
Copy this file to deck.json (`cp TEMPLATE.json deck.json`) so app.js can fetch it directly, or just paste the contents into the in-app import box.

sections.title: Section name from the course outline

points.point: The rule, in your own words — the thing you must be able to restate without looking
points.why: Why the near-miss answer is wrong, or the number/date the examiner likes to swap.

sections.body:
Or use free-form prose instead of points. Markdown-lite: **bold**, `code`, and lines starting with '- '.

Leave "points" empty if you use "body".

flashcards.back: Answer. Newlines become paragraphs; '- ' lines become bullets.
flashcards.section: Section name from the course outline

questions.section: Section name from the course outline
